name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.exists_extend_form
summary: Extend t ↦ μ(1⊗t) B_cris-linearly to Λ; each crystalline cocycle α(c) is a coboundary gv_c − v_c, so Λ(v_c) is invariant modulo W and congruent to a constant a_c; these are choices for each c, with no asserted linearity in c, so ν is defined on a Z_p-basis (e_j) of C by ν(1⊗e_j) = Λ(v_{e_j}) − a_{e_j} and extended linearly; take μ∘wittFst + ν∘projTriv, and check invariance by expanding an arbitrary c in the basis.

steps.claim: Let Λ be the B_cris-linear extension of t ↦ μ(1 ⊗ t) to B_cris ⊗ Y.
Λ is Γ'-equivariant: Λ((j(g) ⊗ ρ(g))y) = g·Λ(y) (induction on tensors; h).
steps.lean:
have H (g : k.Γ') y : Λ (tensorAction _ (toGp g.1) (S.ρ g) y) = toGp g.1 • Λ y := by
    induction y <;> simp_all [Λ, tensorAction, h _, smul_def']
steps.typed_fact: Λ (tensorAction _ (toGp g.1) (S.ρ g) y) = toGp g.1 • Λ y

steps.claim: For each c ∈ C, α(c) is a crystalline cocycle: choose v_c ∈ B_cris⊗Y with 1 ⊗ α(c)(g) = g·v_c − v_c (F).
Applying Λ: μ(1 ⊗ α(c)(g)) = g·Λ(v_c) − Λ(v_c) for g ∈ Γ'.
steps.lean: have f c (g : k.Γ') := by simpa [↓H, Λ] using congr(Λ $(F c g))

steps.claim: As these lie in W (m), Λ(v_c) − a_c ∈ W for some a_c in the fixed field (BdR.exists_sub_mem_of_smul_sub_mem).
steps.lean: choose a b d using fun c ↦ by simpa using BdR.exists_sub_mem_of_smul_sub_mem k.Γ' W (f c · ▸ m _)

steps.claim: Let e be a Z_p-basis of C.
Choose a functional ν on W(C^♭)⊗C (trivial lattice) with ν(1 ⊗ e_j) = Λ(v_{e_j}) − a_{e_j} (exists_functional_extend).
steps.lean:
let ⟨ν, q⟩ :=
    S.trivLattice.exists_functional_extend (e.constr ℕ ((Λ ∘ v - algebraMap _ _ ∘ a) ∘ e))

steps.claim: Take μ ∘ wittFst(S) + ν ∘ projTriv(S): it maps the A_inf-lattice into W (on generators 1⊗(t, c): μ(1⊗t) ∈ W, and ν(1⊗c) = Σ_j r_j·(Λ(v_{e_j}) − a_{e_j}) ∈ W for c = Σ_j r_j e_j, r_j ∈ Z_p) and restricts to μ on Y; invariance remains:
steps.lean:
use μ ∘ₗ ↑S.wittFst + ν ∘ₗ S.projTriv.wittMap, fun (t, c) g ↦ ?_, span_le.2 ?_, LinearMap.ext
    (diagTensor_induction ?_) <;> simp [Λ, sum_mem, smul_of_tower_mem, add_mem_cancel_left, *]

steps.claim: g·(t, c) = (gt + α(c)(g), c) (extensionRep), and α is linear in c: μ(1 ⊗ α(c)(g)) = Σ_j r_j·μ(1 ⊗ α(e_j)(g)) = Σ_j r_j·(gΛ(v_{e_j}) − Λ(v_{e_j})) = Σ_j r_j·(g − 1)(Λ(v_{e_j}) − a_{e_j}) = g·ν(1 ⊗ c) − ν(1 ⊗ c), the a_{e_j} being fixed; so the sum is invariant. (The chosen v_c, a_c are used only at the basis vectors e_j: c ↦ v_c, a_c need not be linear.)
steps.lean: simp [*, extensionRep, -Basis.sum_repr, smul_sum, smul_sub, smul_comm, h t, add_assoc]
